title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-28
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Doug Lamarre; nak 300’s > sony d5m, fob; maxell mx90’s, dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark ADC1 24/96 > tascam HD-P2,compact flash > mac > adobe audition > fission > 16/44.1 > xACT flac; transferred and seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Zesty first‑set performance captured despite pouring rain, with good listening energy and acceptable audience recording quality
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises a lively, zest‑filled first set where the band sounds in sync, even though the tape was recorded in heavy rain. The ambient rain adds some background noise but doesn’t detract from the overall enjoyment, resulting in a solid listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review highlights strong musical energy and a decent recording despite rain; show quality is high, recording quality good but impacted by ambient noise.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded in pouring rain – background ambience audible, some muddiness expected, but overall clear enough to enjoy the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as zestful and tightly listening, indicating a smooth, engaging flow.
